detected_fault: Lag, stuttering, high CPU usage during gaming, occasional freezing, poor performance in games previously playable
suggested_solution: Update graphics drivers to the latest version.
Disable unnecessary startup applications and debloat the PC.
Monitor CPU, GPU, and RAM usage during gaming and idle periods using Task Manager.
Check for dust buildup in fans and consider cleaning them if necessary.
Consider using a dedicated GPU or alternative gaming solutions like Nvidia GeForce Now.
